notes.title: Major Update finally here!
notes.notes:
PingBall just got a major update:

-Now a total of 20 original Levels.
-Fans that disturb the trajectory of the balls.
-Steam Leaderboard for each difficulty, you can now compare your skill with the world.
-Choice of offline mode if you are shy and prefer to compete locally.
-New refreshed user interface.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28434071/8a85eec03a9f5e7acb530f26cc2037fe7df8b8ae.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28434071/c005a2c701c735a2e501160b5d0e768df727a597.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28434071/a0809b6cf5dd0e9a2603ae4155fb91d3587b8670.png

Enjoy and thank you for all your support!
